facts.fact: The MoCTI Directorate of Technology, with a Software Development and Application Services Unit and a Data Science Unit, is stated to be mandated to support MDAs in planning, deploying and maintaining software, to build and maintain government-wide data infrastructure, and to direct delivery of e-Cabinet, e-Parliament and citizen portals; the page gives no date for the stated thing, so the published date is used.

note: Mandate page; no named system is stated as run, maintained or developed by directorate staff, and no go-live or cadre is stated, so only the agency fact is recorded.
Companion page holds citation and structure only (body_completeness excerpt); the findings sit in the artefact, which this page does not carry.
A training course for over 100 MDA ICT officers (World Bank-supported); names no government system run, built or staffed in-house, and no cadre.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance's DFMST, established in 2022, lists providing technical support to mission critical systems such as IFMIS and CSDRMS among its core functions.

facts.fact: Tech Africa News reports that under the Website Standardisation Framework the Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation builds and hosts official websites for ministries, departments and agencies on shared gov.sl infrastructure.
Tech Africa News reports that ICT officers within individual ministries, departments and agencies will manage and update their own websites on the gov.sl platform.

facts.fact: OWLPRESS reports that the Directorate of Science, Technology and Innovation (DSTI) was commissioned in July 2025 to develop for the Ministry of Energy a national energy dashboard, a GIS database of energy assets and a market operations portal.

systems.owner: Ministry of Energy; built by DSTI
